source_identity.source_title: Island biodiversity in peril: Anticipating a loss of mammals' functional diversity with future species extinctions

public_metadata_basis.response_description: presence/absence matrix of mammal species by island with bibliographic sources; islands grouped by zoogeographical region
public_metadata_basis.safe_mixed_file_description: island physical/environmental/history variables plus response-derived functional/richness summaries

ecological_hypothesis.name: archipelago_source_pool_handoff_mammals
ecological_hypothesis.statement: Among islands with a prospectively valid mammal presence/absence codebook, species occurrence on the most continent-isolated islands should retain information from the occupied source pool on other islands in the same archipelago beyond island area, climate, past land-bridge connectivity, distance to continent, distance to a larger landmass, and response-independent archipelago size.

primary_regime_prediction.primary_extreme_rule: upper 25% of frozen response-independent eligible-island distance-to-continent distribution
primary_regime_prediction.prediction: C_minus_R3 is more favourable in the extreme-isolation tail than outside it

past_connectivity.prediction: within-archipelago source support is stronger for islands lacking recent land-bridge connection to a continent

dispersal_mode.prediction: current archipelago source-pool support is relatively stronger for bats; past connectivity has relatively greater explanatory importance for non-volant mammals

proposed_partition_rule.eligible_archipelago_rule: at least 4 safe-metadata islands before response access
proposed_partition_rule.split_rule: within each eligible archipelago, rank islands by SHA256('mammal-source-pool-v1|' + archipelago + '|' + island_id); assign max(2,ceil(20%)) to pilot provided at least 2 confirmatory islands remain
proposed_partition_rule.heldout_design: leave-one-island-out within each frozen pilot or confirmatory partition
proposed_partition_rule.reason: candidate source-pool feature requires other islands from the same archipelago to remain available as training sources

source_pool_operator.fixed_species_universe_rule: must be frozen after response schema/domain validation and before any pilot response access; must be identical across held-out islands to preserve v0.32 complement arithmetic
source_pool_operator.candidate: fraction of other training islands in the focal island's archipelago occupied by the focal species
source_pool_operator.breadth_conditioner: fraction of all other training islands occupied by the focal species

response_schema_requirements: exact workbook sheet names frozen before response-value access
island ID field and mapping to data_models_islands.ID established schema-only
presence/absence value domain completely enumerated before pilot
introduced/native status semantics frozen if represented
bibliographic/source columns separated from occurrence values
no unexpected categorical response code may be interpreted after pilot access
